commands.command:
$taskRoot=(Resolve-Path wef-live).Path
$taskEvidence=Join-Path $taskRoot 'evidence/live-cadence-20261102'
$taskManifest=Get-Content "$taskEvidence/candidate-hashes.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$taskCandidateMatches=@($taskManifest | ForEach-Object { @{file=(Split-Path $_.path -Leaf);matches=((Get-FileHash $_.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -eq $_.sha256)} })
$taskBaselineMatches=@(Get-ChildItem "$taskEvidence/baseline" -Filter *.js | ForEach-Object { @{file=$_.Name;matches=((Get-FileHash $_.FullName).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash (Join-Path $taskRoot $_.Name)).Hash)} })
$taskInstalled=(Export-ScheduledTask -TaskName wef-live-collector).Trim()
$taskBefore=(Get-Content "$taskEvidence/task-before.xml" -Raw).Trim()
$taskOriginal=[xml]$taskBefore
$taskPrepared=[xml](Get-Content "$taskEvidence/task-prepared.xml" -Raw)
$taskExpected=$taskBefore.Replace('<Duration>PT14H</Duration>','<Duration>PT24H</Duration>').Replace('<StopAtDurationEnd>true</StopAtDurationEnd>','<StopAtDurationEnd>false</StopAtDurationEnd>')
$taskPriorLog=Get-Content "$taskEvidence/offline-final.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
@{candidate_hashes_match=(@($taskCandidateMatches|Where-Object{-not $_.matches}).Count -eq 0);production_matches_frozen_baseline=(@($taskBaselineMatches|Where-Object{-not $_.matches}).Count -eq 0);installed_task_unchanged=($taskInstalled -eq $taskBefore);prepared_task_only_expected_changes=((Get-Content "$taskEvidence/task-prepared.xml" -Raw).Trim() -eq $taskExpected);prior_offline_exit_code=$taskPriorLog.commands[0].exit_code;prior_test_count=71;tests_reused_not_rerun=$true;new_module_installed=(Test-Path "$taskRoot/live-cadence.js");candidate=$taskCandidateMatches} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
